thesis.infer: Price eased while OI fell and funding sat near zero, so we read a mild unwind of the leverage that built earlier in the week, not crowded carry; ETH and SOL funding remain within normal range. Consensus is pricing a hold on Oct 28; we read the risk as a hawkish tone given the 10Y above 5%. The disagreement: Fear & Greed is stretched (z30 +2.43) while stablecoin supply is shrinking and the Macro lens is Restrictive, so risk skews toward a fragile, sentiment-led advance if the dollar firms.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC holds above the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close below $81.7K breaks it and is hl-cycles' stated invalidation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below the True Market Mean ($79.4K) could put the STH cost basis ($74.6K) in play. Second tail case (low-confidence): a dovish hold with oil under $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and support a move toward the Mean MVRV price ($105.7K), far overhead.
